name: naver_search_ads-mcp
display_name: 네이버 검색광고 Naver Search Ads MCP
description: 네이버 검색광고 Naver Search Ads (ads): me, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume. Every

platform_mcp_naver_search_ads_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NAVER_SEARCH_ADS_API_KEY
platform_mcp_naver_search_ads_api_key.description: API license (access license) from NAVER Search Advertiser's Center > Tools > API Manager, sent as X-API-KEY.

platform_mcp_naver_search_ads_secret_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NAVER_SEARCH_ADS_SECRET_KEY
platform_mcp_naver_search_ads_secret_key.description: The license's secret key; signs every request: X-Signature = base64(HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<X-Timestamp ms>.<METHOD>.<path>")).

platform_mcp_naver_search_ads_customer_i.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NAVER_SEARCH_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID
platform_mcp_naver_search_ads_customer_i.description: Numeric advertiser customer id (shown in the Search Advertiser's Center), sent as X-Customer and as customerId in campaign updates.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /billing/bizmoney: the advertiser's bizmoney (prepaid balance) record for the X-Customer account; verifies the license, secret and customer id.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /ncc/campaigns?recordSize=… (campaigns of the X-Customer account, a JSON array). `budget` is dailyBudget in KRW, applied only when useDailyBudget is true (in raw); userLock=true means paused. Paging is cursor-style (baseSearchId + selector), so only the first page is returned; `account_id` and `status` are not sent.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: GET /stats?id=<campaign_id>&fields=["impCnt","clkCnt","salesAmt","ctr","cpc","ccnt"]&timeRange={"since","until"}&timeIncrement=1: daily stats of one campaign (KST days). campaign_id is REQUIRED (the endpoint reports one entity). `spend` is salesAmt, the cost in KRW including VAT. `account_id` is not sent (X-Customer selects the account).

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: PUT /ncc/campaigns/{campaign_id}?fields=budget {nccCampaignId, customerId, useDailyBudget: true, dailyBudget} sets the campaign's daily budget in whole KRW (an integer; fractional values are refused) and switches the daily cap on. This spends money. `currency` is ignored (KRW).

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: PUT /ncc/campaigns/{campaign_id}?fields=userLock {nccCampaignId, customerId, userLock}: userLock=true pauses (the advertiser's ON/OFF switch), false resumes. Naver's sample client (Campaigns.update) sends the Campaign object with fields=userLock.
